meta.name: PickleballTV
meta.description:
PickleballTV is a new 24-hour streaming network covering 1,000+ hours of live tournament matches that feature the game’s top professionals & biggest stars.  PBTV will also feature first-class instruction, lifestyle shows and pickleball news.

Shows: PPA Tour Pickleball, PPA Tour: Virginia Beach Open, Brighter Pickleball: On Tour, PPA Tour: Mesa Cup, PPA Tour: Las Vegas Open
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
